OUR COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY
B&W operates in a challenging, continually changing and highly competitive market. We know that attracting, developing and retaining qualified executives who increase stockholder value by achieving our financial and strategic growth plans remains key to our success. We emphasize pay-for-performance, rewarding those who achieve or exceed their goals, and we use short- and long-term incentives to drive continued strong results for our stockholders.

• Incent and reward annual and long-term performance;
• Align interests of B&W executives with stockholders; and
• Attract and retain well-qualified executives.

Each CPU represents the right to receive an amount in cash equal to the “measurement value” of our stock at the time of vesting.
